title: Broadway 8 mins-Rooftop-PingPong-6 mins Opry Mills
description:
🏠 Enjoy Nashville from your huge, private rooftop patio with stunning skyline views! This modern newer home features 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, with plenty of space to spread out. A fully equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, free parking, and stylish living spaces. Just 6 min from Gaylord Opryland, Grand Ole Opry, and Opry Mills Mall, with easy access to Downtown Nashville, Broadway, concerts, events, restaurants & grocery stores. Perfect for couples, families, business travelers, & weekend trips🔑

The space
Bedrooms:
New memory foam mattresses (twin to queen sizes)
Tall ceilings and abundant natural light
Spacious open floor plans for a balance of privacy and community

Kitchen:
Barstool seating for 4
Three-story open floor plan to keep the cooks in the loop with the fun and TV
Kitchen equipped with pots, pans, storage containers, coffee maker, wine glasses, and corkscrews
Supplies for cooking or reheating meals

Living Room:
Mounted TV with streaming
TV also available in 1 of 2 bedrooms
Technology & Security:
Fast internet with AT&T fiber
Ring security system
Smart keypad for entry
Smart thermostat

Additional Amenities:
Towels, linens, irons & boards
2 hair dryers
New Samsung washer and dryer with detergent
Wi-Fi, streaming, and more provided

Guest access
Access to the entire townhome as well as two car garage. Smart keypad to enter.

Other things to note
